_comment: Copy this file to %USERPROFILE%\.snapit\voice-config.json and fill in your own values. It configures lib/camarita-bridge.py, the optional voice -> agent bridge.
_tokens_comment: Any long random strings you choose. callback_token authenticates POST /events (header X-Camarita-Token); camera_token is sent to your camera_api as a Bearer token.
_network_comment: The bridge only listens on loopback by default. Use a private address (for example a Tailscale IP) only if you really need remote clients.
_camera_comment: Optional service that receives /v1/voice/hotkey/start and /v1/voice/hotkey/stop. Leave the default if you are not using one.
_alert_comment: Loudness (0-1) of the confirmation beeps played through your speakers.
_mirror_comment: Optional: POST each normalized voice event as JSON to mirror_url for auditing.
